name: solid
description: Solid 2.0 primer and diagnostic-code repair skills for coding agents, shipped with solid-js.

interface.longDescription: The skills that ship in the solid-js package: the Solid 2.0 primer (props are read not destructured, two-function createEffect, writing stores through the draft, and the 1.x to 2.0 corrections) and a reactivity-diagnostics skill that maps dev diagnostic codes such as STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED or REACTIVE_WRITE_IN_OWNED_SCOPE to their repair.
defaultPrompt: Review this component for Solid 2.0 mistakes
What does STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED mean and how do I fix it?
